coordinator_attestation: Root loaded retained page through digest-verifying EvidenceStore and supplied row 6 in the task. This cloud worker transcribed that supplied JSON; no VPS/provider access or independent signature/finality authentication.
supported_subset: Explicit parsed static roster, no header/ALT/loaded addresses, exact four-field nullable config, bounded complete balance/inner arrays and explicit stack heights. Provider writable flags may be runtime-demoted; they do not reconstruct signed header ordering or CPI privileges. Encoded authorities need not appear in static keys.
failed_records: Valid supported parsed-v1 failures return FAILED and no funding/accounting/program links; malformed or compiled-v1 failures reject before observation creation. This conservative v1-only rule preserves legacy/v0 early-return behavior.
wire_limit: Visible wire fields provide only a 4096-byte lower-bound check; parsed instruction bytes and exact signed wire are unavailable. JSON diagnostic depth/node/UTF8 bounds are separate from canonical wire limits.
